text:
maya: Hey team — first week! Trying to access the cluster from my home network but kubectl can't reach the API (timeouts). I have the kubeconfig we uploaded to my home directory. Anyone know if we should be using the jump host / SSH tunnel or the VPN? @aaron?

aaron: welcome! usually we ask new hires to use the company VPN or the jump host. Quick checks: run `kubectl config current-context` and `kubectl cluster-info` — paste output if stuck. If the API endpoint is an internal IP/hostname you'll need a tunnel or VPN.

maya: current-context is `redwood-dev`. `kubectl cluster-info` errors with: `Unable to connect to the server: dial tcp 10.12.34.56:6443: i/o timeout`

aaron: yep that's an internal IP. Two options:
1) Join the company VPN (preferred).
2) SSH tunnel via our jump host. Example port-forward to API: `ssh -L 6443:10.12.34.56:6443 maya@jump.redwood.com -N` then in a new shell `kubectl --server=https://127.0.0.1:6443 get ns`.
If you want a SOCKS proxy instead (less typing): `ssh -D 1080 maya@jump.redwood.com -N` then `export HTTPS_PROXY=socks5://127.0.0.1:1080`. Note: some tooling doesn't handle SOCKS/TLS host validation well — the direct port-forward (`-L`) is more reliable for kubectl.

sam_devex: another option for short-term dev access is cloudflared dev tunnels (dev-only) — see https://redwood.internal/devex/tunnels. If you choose VPN, ping @people-ops for VPN creds.

maya: trying the tunnel now... getting `Permission denied (publickey)`. I don't have an SSH key on my jump.

aaron: create a key: `ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "maya@redwood"` then paste your `~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub` into the infra self-service portal: https://infra.redwood.internal/ssh-keys. If you prefer I can add it for you — ping me the key or open a help ticket.

maya: added key to the portal — tunnel succeeded, `kubectl get ns` works now. Thanks! Quick Q: do I need RBAC for namespace access? I couldn't list pods across namespaces.

sam_devex: by default new hires get limited dev namespace perms (team namespace + dev). Check with `kubectl auth can-i list pods --namespace team-maya`. If it says `no` file a short request in #help or mention @aaron with the namespaces you need.

aaron: created infra ticket INFRA-789 to scope your namespace permissions and assigned it to myself. If you need cluster-admin for a short time, tell me the reason and duration. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Ticket INFRA-789 created. ETA 1 business day.

maya: awesome, thanks both! heading to pair with the team now. :wave:
